text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the minor maintenance 
procedures I4, which must be carried out from after yearly as indicated by Y1 
in the title block.
This procedure was applied in 
Damanhour Thermal Power Plant3*65mw since 1976. The generator data: 81.25MVA, 10.5KV, 4.45KA, 
PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm, Y connection
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Mohamed Fatehy AboElkher, tested by eng.Samir 
Ouf Hassoub , accepted by general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector of Damanhour power station, 
and certified by eng. Sania Diab Attia Diab WDEPC inspection head sector and 
MPIS coordinator.
Safety 
Precautions
Work order must be 
 issued before start work and the qualified maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear your safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, safety clothes and breathing mask when cleaning. ... 
 etc,
The generator in case 
 of shut down.
The circuit breaker of 
 generator on test position.
Put ground on the 
 generator windings.
Don't burn the cloth 
 used in cleaning, collect it and send it to the dump
Tools and 
Equipment
Complete tool set
New brushes, Air blower, 
 and Spray
Digital voltmeter, megger, 
 clamp ammeter
Fine cloth and brushes 
 for cleaning purposes
Work to be carried out
stator
Measure insulation resistance
Carry out hydrostatic test .
Rotor
Measure insulation resistance
Inspect bearing surfaces and shaft collars .
Check ventilating duct for slip ring leads .
Clean and inspect slip rings .
Inspect slip ring brushes .
Inspect brush holders .
Check coupling flange and coupling at turbine and exciter ends .
Check alignment .
Bearing
Inspect bearing insulation .
Thorough cleaning of bearing .
Inspect bearing sleeves .
Inspect oil pipes .
Check spherical seats .
Inspect oil grooves and pipes for oil jacking .
Perform checking of oil jacking pump .
Inspect pressure control valve and non-return .
Inspect drains at oil vapour extractor and pressure breaker pipes .
Clean and inspect non- return valve of oil vapour extractor .
Check oil pipes .
Seal oil supply system
Check seal oil pumps ,motors .
Inspect oil supple pressure controller , over flow valve and reliet 
 valve .
Inspect seal oil pressure controller .
Check oil filters and clean ,if required .
Check automatic seal oil control system .
Inspect isolation and non return valves .
Check performance of solenoid valves .
Check pressure gouge stop valves .
Vent and check of pressure gouge , check contact setting .
Check performance of pressure gauge .
Check thermometers .
Exciter set
Check brush assembly and adjust neutral axis .
Check field rheostat and voltage regulator .
Coolers
Inspect H2 coolers on waters side and clean if required .
Checking of vents
Inspect H2 cooler gasket (on air side)
Inspect seal oil cooler gaskets
Shaft seals
Measure insulation resistance
Check oil tightness
Check sliding faces of seal rings seal guides and seal 
 housings.
Hydrogen system
Check H2 pressure reduces .
Inspect diaphragm and selector valves .
Check gas pressure breaker .
